title: Start-Stop Operation Disabled - Battery State of Charge Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: start-stop operation disabled - battery state of charge low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates start-stop operation disabled - battery state of charge low fault. The PCM monitors start-stop enable conditions and engine restart behavior; when an enable criterion fails or restart performance is out of spec, the code matures and start-stop is inhibited.

The vehicle remains drivable but auto-stop functionality will be unavailable until the underlying condition is repaired.
safetyImpact: No immediate driving safety impact; fuel economy reduced.

causes.cause: Sensor or switch out of range (brake/steering/HVAC)

symptoms: Auto stop-start indicator off or amber
Engine does not auto-stop at idle

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect related sensors, harness, connectors, and components for damage, corrosion, or contamination.

fixSteps.title: Electrical/functional test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector; perform manufacturer-specific actuator/monitor test.

fixSteps.title: Replace component or perform service procedure
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect component or perform required relearn and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes for short distances if engine runs normally; otherwise flatbed.
No - sensor or component replacement is typically required.

title: Hybrid Battery Pack Temperature Sensor B Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: hybrid battery pack temperature sensor b circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates hybrid battery pack temperature sensor b circuit fault. The hybrid powertrain controller monitors battery pack temperature sensors against learned thresholds; when the signal is out of range, implausible, or intermittent, the code matures.

HV battery thermal faults can derate output power, disable EV mode, or place the vehicle in service mode.
safetyImpact: Reduced power; risk of thermal event if pack overheats undetected.

title: 48V Mild Hybrid DC/DC Converter Output Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: 48v mild hybrid dc/dc converter output low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates 48v mild hybrid dc/dc converter output low fault. The mild-hybrid controller monitors 48V subsystem performance, BSG torque, DC/DC converter output, and 48V battery balance; when a parameter exceeds spec, the code matures and the 48V system enters limp or off mode.

The vehicle continues to operate on the 12V system but loses regen, torque assist, and stop-start refinement.
safetyImpact: Vehicle drivable on 12V; mild hybrid features lost.

causes.cause: BSG belt slip or tensioner failure

safetyImpact: Emissions exceedance; possible MIL flash on misfire-related conditions.

causes.cause: O2 sensor connectors swapped after service

title: Ambient Air Temperature Sensor Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: ambient air temperature sensor circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates ambient air temperature sensor circuit fault. The PCM compares O2 sensor cross-counts and bank correlation; if signals appear swapped or a heater circuit fails, the monitor matures.

Fuel trim accuracy and catalyst monitor will be affected; emissions may rise.
safetyImpact: Emissions exceedance; possible MIL flash on misfire-related conditions.

causes.cause: O2 sensor connectors swapped after service

title: Mass Air Flow Sensor B Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: mass air flow sensor b circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates mass air flow sensor b circuit fault. The PCM monitors the secondary MAF channel against MAP and primary MAF inputs; when the cross-check disagrees beyond tolerance the code matures.

Dual-MAF systems are used on twin-turbo and split-intake engines — failure causes torque-management restrictions.
safetyImpact: Reduced power and possible misfire if fueling is incorrect.

causes.cause: Air leak between MAF and throttle body

title: Hybrid Battery Cell Voltage Sense Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: hybrid battery cell voltage sense circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates hybrid battery cell voltage sense circuit fault. The BMS samples each cell or cell-group voltage and runs passive balancing; when a sense lead opens, shorts, or a balancing FET fails, the code matures.

Unbalanced cells reduce usable pack capacity and can trigger derate or shutdown.
safetyImpact: Reduced power; risk of pack damage if balancing fails long-term.

causes.cause: Open or pinched cell sense lead
Failed balancing FET on BMS slave board
Aged module with high internal resistance
